title: Travel & Expense Analyst
why_fit: 2-3 years in expense or financial operations; his reconciliation automation and payment review work map to policy checks and GL coding (no Brex experience).
why_us: Onebrief's team works with customers around the world, so travel and corporate spend has to run cleanly, and this role owns it end to end. I like that it goes beyond approving receipts: you look for anomalies, tighten controls and find savings through vendor consolidation. At AMG Family Dental I reconcile insurance payments, flag underpaid claims and report variances to ownership, and I automated that weekly reconciliation in Python, cutting it from 5 hours to 1. That same habit of catching what does not match, then fixing the process, is what this role asks for.
cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am applying for the Travel & Expense Analyst role at Onebrief. Your posting describes a role that owns expense review, GL coding and out-of-policy travel from start to finish, and that is also expected to find anomalies and savings. That mix of detail work and process improvement is what I do now.

I am the Financial Manager at AMG Family Dental in Belmont, where I direct financial operations for a practice serving more than 1,000 patients a year. I oversee billing, collections and revenue tracking, and I reconcile insurance payments in Dentrix. By improving our reporting and reconciliation processes, I identified and recovered more than $500K in annual revenue. I also automated our weekly insurance payment reconciliation with Python, which cut processing time from 5 hours to 1 and flagged underpaid claims for follow-up.

Earlier, as a Financial Analyst Intern at Northrop Grumman, I audited more than 100 financial models for accuracy, compliance and internal controls, and I analyzed supplier costs and budget variances across programs, then presented cost-saving recommendations to senior leadership.

I should be direct about one gap: I have not managed corporate cards in Brex. I hold an M.A. in International Economics & Finance from Brandeis and a B.S. in Business Administration with a Finance major from Suffolk. I am a U.S. citizen, available immediately, and comfortable working remotely.

Thank you for your time. I would welcome the chance to talk about how I can keep Onebrief's spend clean and help Finance close with confidence.

Sincerely,
Alexander Airapetian

title: Deal Desk Analyst (Eastern Time Zone Preferred)

cover_letter:

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am writing about the Fund Administration Analyst opening on BBH's Fund Administration team in Boston. The role combines financial reporting for registered and non-registered investment companies with the daily running of expense administration, and it depends on accuracy, controls and clear communication with managers and auditors. Those are the parts of finance where I have built my experience.

At AMG Family Dental in Belmont, I have been Financial Manager since August 2023. I direct financial operations, build the annual operating budget and monthly forecasts, and prepare budget-vs-actual variance analysis and KPI reports for ownership. I reconcile insurance payments in Dentrix and automated that weekly reconciliation with Python, which reduced the work from 5 hours to 1 and flagged underpaid claims for follow-up. Better reporting and reconciliation also led me to recover more than $500K in annual revenue.

Your posting lists at least three years in audit, financial reporting or a related finance area as desired, and I am close to that with about three years of finance experience, though not in fund administration. I have not prepared fund financial statements or worked with Regulation S-X, and I expect to learn that on the job.

I am a U.S. citizen, based in the Boston area, and available immediately. Thank you for your consideration.

Sincerely,
Alexander Airapetian
